summary: No result-changing defect was found in this commit range. The new manifest generator correctly derives the 17 Machine B data inputs from the current preflight and compares their SHA-256 hashes; the main unresolved issue is that the external files and reported hashes could not be independently accessed or recomputed.

verified_clean.item: The generated manifest covers exactly the data inputs currently preflighted by Machine B.
verified_clean.evidence: The preflight declares 13 literal data files and four mortality variants at replication/run_machineB.do:50-68. The parser expands those declarations and requires 17 distinct paths at replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py:47-63; those paths correspond one-for-one to the 17 rows at replication/input_manifest_machineB.md:11-27.

verified_clean.item: Checksum comparison detects changed or newly introduced current inputs and fails with a nonzero status.
verified_clean.evidence: Each file is hashed with the shared SHA-256 helper and compared by manifest label at replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py:97-105; check mode reports discrepancies and exits 1 when any are found at replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py:108-112.

verified_clean.item: The manifest generator fails early on the wrong machine, an unparseable configuration, unexpected input count, duplicate input paths, or missing files.
verified_clean.evidence: The configuration and input-list guards are at replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py:37-44 and replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py:47-63; hostname and existence checks are at replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py:82-91.

verified_clean.item: The README accurately limits checksum coverage to the frozen analysis-tier files and discloses that raw build-tier inputs remain unhashed.
verified_clean.evidence: replication/README.md:254-263 distinguishes the 17 Machine B data inputs and five git-versioned code inputs from the still-unhashed raw build-tier files.

verified_clean.item: The new provenance entries do not conceal uncertainty about source derivation, dates, or redistribution terms.
verified_clean.evidence: The MLP row explicitly says the extraction is absent and only 'almost certainly' identified, while both new rows qualify file dates and terms at replication/README.md:80-81. The remaining provenance uncertainties are reiterated at replication/README.md:264-267.

verified_clean.item: No empirical Stata or Python analysis logic changed in this range, so the diff introduces no new estimation, linkage-selection, agreement-rate, missing-value, or merge behavior.
verified_clean.evidence: The range changes only replication/README.md, replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py, and replication/input_manifest_machineB.md; the table-producing inputs referenced by replication/run_machineB.do:44-68 were not modified.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so claims-vs-code review was limited to claims in the changed README; paper claims could not be checked.
The 66.8 GB external Machine B inputs were outside the readable repository, so the committed SHA-256 values, byte counts, and modification dates could not be independently recomputed.
The checksum script's full execution was unavailable because it intentionally requires hostname ARTS-ECON-SHSRV at replication/hash_inputs_machineB.py:83-84 and external files under $REP_LINK.
The Stata pipeline was not run, so this review cannot independently establish that the frozen inputs reproduce the reported tables.
The asserted dataset origins, licence terms, and file-date history depend on evidence outside the repository and were not independently verified.
